purpose: Run BulkBite as a rolling customer-led meal cycle through planning, buying, receipts, production, reports, and stock truth
audience: Signed-in BulkBite staff deciding what to update, buy, receive, cook, measure, report, and reconcile
primaryAction: Open and complete the next required operational task

brandGuidance.name: BulkBite Operations
brandGuidance.purpose: Provide a self-explanatory BulkBite stock dashboard with a restrained charcoal-and-muted-orange shell around calm neutral operational work surfaces

composition.hierarchy: Use a compact page title, one-sentence purpose, visible workflow stages, one main work area, and a separate review or posting boundary.
composition.negativeSpace: Use calm dashboard spacing. Group each decision with its evidence and next action while keeping repeated rows efficient.
composition.geometry: Use a compact collapsible soft-charcoal setup rail, one calm muted-orange top area, separated horizontal workflow navigation, neutral work surfaces, soft borders, and generous but consistent rounding.
composition.density: Keep forms and tables efficient without making the task feel cramped. Touch targets remain at least 44 pixels high.
composition.lighting: Use restrained surface elevation and tonal separation. No decorative lighting, gradients, textures, or atmospheric effects.

primitiveTreatment.rule: Keep solid-field available as the required fallback primitive, but do not mount visual primitives in ordinary operations views. Structure comes from flow, spacing, semantic surface levels, and soft borders.

recipeTreatment.rule: Keep precision-frame available for an exceptional evidence boundary, but do not apply decorative recipes to ordinary operational pages.

blockTreatment.rhythm: Orient the user, show numbered stages, present one current work area, then expose review and posting as an explicit final boundary.

motion.character: Still by default. Use only provider-native state transitions required for control feedback.
motion.reduced: Render final state immediately; no meaning or hierarchy depends on movement.

brandGuidance.responsive: Protect state, units, evidence, and action order. Collapse columns before reducing targets or hiding labels.
prohibitions: Use muted orange only for the top shell area, active workflow emphasis, warnings that require it, and the primary action. Routine keyboard focus uses neutral high contrast.
Do not use Anton, campaign slogans, oversized all-caps headings, black feature panels, or poster composition in the dashboard.
Do not mount decorative primitives, recipes, or entrance experiences in operational views.
Do not use gradients, glossy surfaces, bright campaign-orange fields, non-collapsible dominant sidebars, or decorative panels.
Do not use white, warm paper, paper shadow, or another near-white value for the sidebar or top shell area.
Do not make the canvas, sidebar, work panels, fields, and popovers the same white surface.
Do not place raw controls in pages when a selected System owner exists.
Do not hide posting, reconciliation, or review state behind menus.
Do not use accounting dimensions in worker entry workflows.

audienceConsequence.actor: Signed-in BulkBite staff deciding what to update, buy, receive, cook, measure, report, and reconcile
audienceConsequence.need: Run BulkBite as a rolling customer-led meal cycle through planning, buying, receipts, production, reports, and stock truth
audienceConsequence.risk: This page fails when Signed-in BulkBite staff deciding what to update, buy, receive, cook, measure, report, and reconcile cannot identify the next relevant action from the ordered blocks.
audienceConsequence.consequence: The Open and complete the next required operational task action must stay reachable, legible, and justified by the preceding content.
audienceConsequence.validationPrompt: Can Signed-in BulkBite staff deciding what to update, buy, receive, cook, measure, report, and reconcile understand the page purpose, locate the main action, and recover if a block fails or is skipped?
audienceConsequence.fallback: If motion, rich surfaces, or optional blocks fail, render the review-today -> complete-workflow -> manage-exceptions -> maintain-system -> ai-upload-review -> structured-importer sequence as readable semantic sections.

alignment.localLayoutRule: The page grid establishes territories. Each block then selects grid, flex, stack, overlay, or flow from its content relationship.
alignment.intentionalOffsets: Any offset must repeat as a page rule; isolated nudges are prohibited.

rhythm.densityProgression: Alternate expansive orientation, compact proof, structured explanation, and decisive action; adjacent blocks must not all carry equal density.
rhythm.verticalCadence: Use one page spacing scale and make section padding changes correspond to narrative importance.
rhythm.adjacency: Block edges meet deliberately; accidental gaps, floating islands, and unrelated container widths are prohibited.

surfaceDistribution.rule: Spend the strongest contrast and richest surface treatment on the focal block; ambient treatments dissolve into their owning field and adjacent surfaces without arbitrary straight seams.

focalHierarchy.rule: Each block must have one focal job and must hand attention to the next block without competing with the page promise.

motifContract.removalRule: No persistent guide, rail, line, or motif exists unless a project brand contract explicitly enables and proves it.

principleContract.traceRule: Every block decision cites principle authority for responsibility, hierarchy, spacing, layout, expression, surface, and motion.
principleContract.rejectionRule: Reject technically valid output when geometry, spacing, layout strategy, surface ownership, action treatment, or motion is arbitrary or untraceable.

motionPlan.signatureRule: Select at most one or two semantic signature mechanisms; Three.js, pinning, FLIP, and card effects require a brand or narrative reason.
motionPlan.reducedMotion: Every experience has a readable final-state equivalent and deterministic teardown.

primitiveGrammar.sharedTopology: Use one coherent topology and origin across the page rather than unrelated effect families.
primitiveGrammar.sharedOrigin: Visual layers align to the page grid, focal content, or a named transition seam; arbitrary origins are prohibited.
primitiveGrammar.removalRule: Every layer must name its hierarchy, structure, continuity, or material job; remove it when the page communicates equally well without it.
primitiveGrammar.edgeContinuity: Ambient primitive layers occupy the full semantic owner and dissolve into its field through fade or continuous color. A sharp edge is permitted only around a semantically bounded object.

connectionContract.dedicatedBlockRule: A connector normally lives in how one block ends, how the next begins, or both edges sharing a field. Insert a dedicated block only when the connector owns meaningful content, narrative, or an intermediate audience state.
connectionContract.gradientRule: Resolve the relationship from both block descriptions first, then compile one full-pair field with a stable substrate, named energy direction, off-boundary source when needed, sufficient falloff depth, and responsive geometry.
